hookText: POV: You caught the manor's new maid in the quiet corridor...
voiceoverScript: In our London manor, I was tidying the attic chamber when I heard a soft rustle. I turned to see my new maid, her dress trailing on the floor, her eyes wide with nervousness. "Ah, miss," she stammered, "is there a matter you desire?" My tallow candle flickered, casting shadows over her face. I smiled, and she flinched, but I could see the warmth in her eyes. #BettyRyal #MaidLife #POV
